meta.name: positioning-statement
meta.description: Create a Geoffrey Moore-style positioning statement. Use when clarifying who you serve, what problem you solve, your category, and why you're different from alternatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建市场定位声明，清晰定义目标用户与差异化优势
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为产品或品牌制定清晰的定位声明。
copy.tagline_en: Create a market positioning statement that defines your target users and differentiation.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to craft a clear positioning statement for your product or brand.

howto.what: 当你要明确产品定位时，Claude 会引导你按 Geoffrey Moore 框架填写目标客户、未满足需求、产品类别、利益及差异化，生成结构化的定位声明。
howto.when: 当你想澄清产品为谁服务、解决什么问题、属于哪一类别、有何不同，或需要对齐团队对产品战略的理解时触发。

say.text: 帮我为我们的B2B SaaS产品写一个定位声明。
say.note: Claude 会引导你填写框架各部分。

say.text: 我想明确新产品相比竞品的差异化，生成定位声明。
say.note: Claude 会要求提供目标客户和竞争对手等信息。

howto.what_en: When you want to clarify product positioning, Claude guides you through the Geoffrey Moore framework: fill in target customer, underserved need, product category, benefit, and differentiation to generate a structured positioning statement.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to clarify who you serve, what problem you solve, your category, and how you're different, or to align stakeholders on product strategy.

say_en.text: Help me write a positioning statement for our B2B SaaS product.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the framework.

say_en.text: I want to clarify differentiation for a new product, generate a positioning statement.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for target customer and competitors.
